# 👋 Hi, I'm ningbojian

I like turning everyday needs into small, working tools. Recently I built GitHub Trending Agent, which delivers daily trending digests to WeCom and supports natural language search plus star syncing. Other works include a six-DOF robotic arm painting pipeline and a Django-based surname culture visualization site. I mostly work with Python and TypeScript, focusing on image processing, web apps and automation.

Highlights:
- github-trending-agent: WeCom daily trending digest and star sync
- RoboArmDev-Showcase: OpenCV/HALCON robotic arm painting pipeline
- shiyuan: Django and MySQL surname culture visualization site
